sources.entry: Medis - GUI Manager for Redis. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/luin/medis)

summary.name: Medis
summary.one_liner: Medis is a GUI manager for browsing and editing Redis databases, with a command query view, tree-style key organization, and an alert mode that requires approval for writes.
use_cases: browse and edit keys in a Redis database
run arbitrary Redis commands with autocomplete
organize Redis keys into a tree
connect to remote Redis servers over SSH or SSL
guard production Redis databases from accidental writes
summary.what_it_does: Medis is a graphical client for Redis that supports strings, lists, hashes, sets, sorted sets, streams, and third-party modules such as RedisJSON. It includes a query view for running arbitrary commands, with keyword highlighting and autocompletion. Keys can be grouped in a customizable tree view. It automatically recognizes data formats, including MessagePack, and can connect to remote servers through an SSH tunnel or over SSL. The page states it is designed to handle databases with millions of keys.
notable: Alert mode requires explicit approval for every writable command sent to servers
Automatic data format recognition including MessagePack
SSH tunnel and SSL connections to remote servers
caveats: The page does not state pricing or licensing terms
Platform support is not named on the page text
